ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity predominance; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of high-intensity white. A continuous low-intensity black band defines the trailing edge boundary. A prominent, vertically-oriented irregular dark pigmentation cluster is located centrally, extending basally from the median notch. Small, discrete dark focal spots are scattered across the medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; internal angle calculated at approximately 58 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency peaks (1-3 pixel height). Right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks (5-8 pixel height) increasing in frequency toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping posteriorly and superiorly. Distal tips exhibit a distinct posterior hook curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast, textured yellowish-white clusters (barnacle colonization) are densely packed on the right distal tip. Minor dark clusters are visible around the central notch region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, low-intensity linear streaks visible on the right lobe surface, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge curvature.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation and associated scarring visible on the distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the upper margin of the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pigmentation pattern resembling an inverted anchor or broad 'T' shape originating at the median notch and extending towards the fluke base.
